title: Landing Login and User Profile Foundation
notes: Moves Firebase email/password sign-in to the MITHRIL Home screen.
Requires a verified user before opening Drill Log or Shot Diagram templates.
Creates a persistent user-profile foundation with display name, role, organization, and account status.
Uses the same authenticated session for Home access and Cloud Sync.
Allows field access through the last verified account when Firebase is temporarily unreachable, while cloud operations remain unavailable offline.
Preserves permanent document identity, Hole Edit rotation, desktop selection highlighting, and existing cloud conflict safeguards.
